name: Yixianopterus
isnote: Assigned to Lonchodectidae (Lü et al. 2006) and later recovered as a basal istiodactyliform (Jiang et al. 2020).
sum: Pterodactyloid from the uppermost Yixian Formation of Liaoning, China; much of the original skull was fabricated by dealers.
holotype: JZMP-V-12 (Benxi Geological Museum) — Jingangshan bed, Yixian Formation, Liaoning.
material: Right forelimb, a foot and teeth (skull largely fabricated).
author: Lü et al. 2006

species.name: Yixianopterus jingangshanensis
species.author: Lü et al. 2006
species.ref: J. Lü, S. Ji, and C. Yuan, Y. Gao, Z. Sun, Q. Ji. 2006. New pterodactyloid pterosaur from the Lower Cretaceous Yixian Formation of Western Liaoning. Papers from the 2005 Heyuan International Dinosaur Symposium. Geological Publishing House, Beijing
